Title: Simple Q: Enrage with only 1 blood.

Messages.Author: adam....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
If a vampire only has one blood on him and enrage on him. Can he only
hunt and rush?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
adam....@gmail.com wrote:
> If a vampire only has one blood on him and enrage on him. Can he only
> hunt and rush?

If it was played at superior, yes.
